optimizations.title: Optimization Task: Exponential Recursion
task: The pre-loaded `calculate_power` algorithm correctly evaluates the mathematical expression but utilizes an unoptimized recursive branching structure.
Refactor the code structure to eliminate redundant recursive invocations, reducing the overall time complexity to O(log n).
1. Examine the Complexity tab to locate the O(n) Global Time bottleneck generated by the dual `calculate_power(n / 2)` calls in the return statement.
2. Remove the redundant second recursive call and the addition operation.
3. Allocate a local variable (e.g., `half`) before the return statement and assign it the result of a single `calculate_power(n / 2)` invocation.
4. Modify the return statement to output the sum of `half + half` (or `half * 2`) to ensure the subproblem is only computed once.
5. Observe the dynamic AST diagnostic feedback adjusting the time requirement to an optimal O(log n) parameter.
